stateRecovery.description: `state_recovery`: how the forward state is recovered for the adjoint of an unsteady run.

algorithm.description: Checkpointing strategy; only the linear one exists. Default `linear`.

n_memory.description: Checkpoints kept in memory; at least 1. Default 10.
n_memory.$comment: checkpoint_linear.f90:69: 0 divides by zero on the first save; checkpoint.f90:425: a negative value allocates no slots and fails later.

path.description: Directory of the checkpoint files. Default `checkpoints/`.

filename.$comment: It is passed to Neko's chkp_output, where Neko's own case.checkpoint_filename is a non-empty string.

format.$comment: A deliberate copy of Neko's inline `case.checkpoint_format` enum (no $defs entry to reference): both go to chkp_output_t%init (checkpoint.f90:155-156, neko src/io/chkp_output.f90:69-74), where `hdf5` gives `.h5` and anything else `.chkp`, so another value would silently run as `chkp`; the enum rejects it.

keep_checkpoints.description: Keep the files after the run. Default false.

extra_fields.description: Names of further registered fields to checkpoint. They must exist when the simulation is initialised, which excludes the design fields (`design_indicator`, `brinkman_amplitude`, `sensitivity`) and the mapping fields (`<type>_mapping`, `<type>_mapping_2`, ...), registered only after the lookup.
extra_fields.$comment: checkpoint.f90:160-165 looks every name up in the registry inside sim%init (simulation.f90:299-301), before the drivers create the design (topopt.f90:93,96); design_brinkman.f90:365-367 and mapping.f90:176-184 register those fields. A name that no startup routine registers aborts with 'Field ... could not be found in the registry' (neko src/registries/registry.f90:562); that cannot be checked here, except for these fixed names.
